title: [resolver]
description:
Dependency resolver behavior for local development.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#resolver

lockfile-path.description:
Path to the lockfile to use when resolving dependencies. Useful with read-only source directories. The path must end with `Cargo.lock`. Requires Cargo 1.97+. Environment: `CARGO_RESOLVER_LOCKFILE_PATH`.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#resolverlockfile-path

incompatible-rust-versions.description:
How dependency versions with incompatible package.rust-version values are treated.
https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#resolverincompatible-rust-versions Default is allow for resolver 1/2 and fallback for resolver 3.

enumValues: Treat rust-version-incompatible versions like any other version.
Only consider rust-version-incompatible versions if no compatible version matched.

allow.description: Treat rust-version-incompatible versions like any other version.

fallback.description: Only consider rust-version-incompatible versions if no compatible version matched.

incompatible-publish-age.description: How to handle versions younger than the minimum publish age. Requires Cargo 1.100+.

feature-unification.description: UNSTABLE: Feature unification scope; requires -Z feature-unification.
